news_title: Ex-Thai PM Thaksin cleared of royal insult charges
news_text: Former Thai prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra was cleared of royal defamation charges, a major reprieve for the politician whose family-backed parties have held sway over the nation's politics for more than two decades. A criminal court in Bangkok yesterday cleared Thaksin of allegations that he had contravened the royal insult law over comments he made to a South Korean media outlet in 2015, his lawyer Winyat Chatmontree said.
